intro.say: Clues help us find answers. Listen carefully and use every clue!

rounds.say: Riddle time! I am an animal. I live on a farm. I say moo. What am I? A cow! The clues told us.
rounds.caption: Farm + moo = cow

rounds.say: Tom is taller than Ann. That also means Ann is shorter than Tom!
rounds.caption: Tom is taller. Ann is shorter.

rounds.ask: I am a number between 3 and 5. What am I?

options.why: 3 is at the edge, not between.
5 is at the edge, not between.

rounds.explain: 4 comes after 3 and before 5, so it is between them.

rounds.ask: I am yellow. I am a fruit. Monkeys love me. What am I?

options.label: Apple
options.why: An apple is red or green.

options.label: Grapes
options.why: These grapes are purple.

rounds.explain: A banana is yellow, it is a fruit, and monkeys love it.

rounds.ask: I have 4 legs and I bark. What am I?

options.label: Cat
options.why: A cat meows.

options.label: Hen
options.why: A hen has 2 legs and clucks.

rounds.explain: A dog has 4 legs and says woof!

rounds.ask: The ball is NOT in the big box. Where is it?

options.label: Big box
options.why: The clue says it is not in the big box.

rounds.explain: There are only two boxes. If it is not in the big one, it is in the small one.

rounds.ask: I come after 6 and before 8. What number am I?

options.why: 9 comes after 8.
5 comes before 6.

rounds.explain: Six, seven, eight. Seven is in the middle.

rounds.ask: Max is taller than Sam. Who is shorter?

options.label: Max
options.why: Max is the taller one.

rounds.explain: If Max is taller, then Sam must be shorter.

intro.say: Let us use if-then clues and chains of clues to solve puzzles.

rounds.say: If it rains, Kim takes her umbrella. It is raining today. So Kim takes her umbrella!
rounds.caption: If rain, then umbrella

rounds.say: Clues can make a chain. A is taller than B. B is taller than C. So A is the tallest of all!
rounds.caption: Tall, taller, tallest

rounds.ask: If it is sunny, Leo wears his hat. Today is sunny. What does Leo wear?

options.label: Gloves
options.why: Gloves are for cold days.

options.label: Scarf
options.why: The clue was about a hat.

rounds.explain: The clue says sunny means hat, and it is sunny.

rounds.ask: Ann is taller than Ben. Ben is taller than Cal. Who is the tallest?

options.label: Ben
options.why: Ann is taller than Ben.

options.label: Cal
options.why: Cal is shorter than Ben.

rounds.explain: Ann is taller than Ben, and Ben is taller than Cal, so Ann is the tallest.

rounds.ask: Same clues: Ann is taller than Ben, Ben is taller than Cal. Who is the shortest?

options.label: Ann
options.why: Ann is the tallest.

options.label: Ben
options.why: Cal is shorter than Ben.

rounds.explain: Cal is shorter than Ben, and Ben is shorter than Ann. So Cal is the shortest.

rounds.ask: I am more than 10 and less than 13. I am an odd number. What am I?

options.why: 12 is even.
13 is not less than 13.

rounds.explain: 11 and 12 are between 10 and 13. Only 11 is odd.

rounds.ask: Mia has the dog. Jo does not have the cat. Each friend has one pet. What does Jo have?

options.label: Dog
options.why: Mia has the dog.

options.label: Cat
options.why: The clue says Jo does not have the cat.

rounds.explain: The dog is Mia's, and Jo does not have the cat, so Jo has the fish.

rounds.ask: The tree is taller than the house. The house is taller than the dog. Put them from shortest to tallest.
rounds.explain: The dog is shortest, then the house, and the tree is the tallest.

intro.say: Real thinkers cross out what cannot be true. What is left is the answer!

rounds.say: The ball is in one of three boxes. It is not in the red box. It is not in the green box. So it must be in the blue box!
rounds.caption: Not red, not green, so blue

rounds.say: Use clues one at a time. Cross out each thing that cannot be right, until only one answer is left.
rounds.caption: Cross out, then check

rounds.ask: I have more legs than a bird but fewer than a spider. I am an insect. What am I?

options.label: Snail
options.why: A snail does not have legs. It slides along on one foot.

options.label: Octopus
options.why: An octopus has 8 arms, the same as a spider has legs.

rounds.explain: An ant has 6 legs: more than a bird's 2 and fewer than a spider's 8.

rounds.ask: Sara, Tim and Ola ran a race. Tim was not first and not last. Ola finished after Sara. Who won?

options.label: Tim
options.why: The clue says Tim was not first.

options.label: Ola
options.why: Ola finished after Sara, so Ola was not first.

rounds.explain: Tim was in the middle. Ola came after Sara, so Sara was first.
rounds.hint: Tim is not first or last. Where must he be?

rounds.ask: I am a 2-digit number. My tens digit is 3. My ones digit is 2 more than my tens digit. What am I?

options.why: The ones digit should be 3 plus 2.
The tens digit is 3, so I start with 3.

rounds.explain: Tens digit 3, ones digit 3 plus 2 makes 5. So the number is 35.

rounds.ask: Every square has 4 sides. This shape has 3 sides. Can it be a square?

options.label: Yes
options.why: A square always needs 4 sides.

options.label: Maybe
options.why: We can be sure: squares always have 4 sides.

rounds.explain: A square always has 4 sides, so a 3 sided shape cannot be a square.

rounds.ask: Ben has more cookies than Ali. Ali has 4. Cara has 2. How many could Ben have?

options.why: 3 is less than Ali's 4.
Ben needs more than Ali, not the same.

rounds.explain: Ben has more than Ali's 4, so 6 is the only answer that fits.

rounds.ask: Liam woke up first. He ate breakfast before he brushed his teeth. He went to school last. Put his morning in order.
rounds.explain: Wake up, breakfast, brush teeth, then school.
